traditional: No classical doctrine: Neptune is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Identity meets imagination and idealism. Heightened sensitivity, imagination, and a pull toward the ideal. The trine makes this a natural strength: Imaginative and compassionate; creative and charitable directions come naturally. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Selfhood and imagination flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what selfhood and imagination have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Creative or service-oriented directions; guard against self-deception and being played.
shadow: The ease lets egotism and needing to be the center and illusion and escapism go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
